metrics.name: FrameRate
metrics.rule: Never invoke synchronous I/O or loop-add to UI collections on the UI thread.

metrics.name: LargeObjectHeapThreshold
metrics.rule: Rent byte/char buffers using ArrayPool<T>.Shared or MemoryPool<T>.Shared.

metrics.name: ArchitectureScanTime
metrics.rule: Run static architecture guardrails via regex AST scanning before full compilation.

metrics.name: StringFormattingAllocations
metrics.rule: Use string.Create and ByteSizeFormatter for high-frequency numeric/span conversions.
